verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs claim fast deployments, isolated container workloads, incremental rollouts, and edge/serverless scaling infrastructure (vercel-docs-6, vercel-docs-12), consistent with edge-compute scale claims, but there's no concrete evidence of sub-second boot times or tens-of-thousands scale benchmarks, and community feedback raises concerns about surprise billing spikes under load/DDoS and unexplained cost jumps (vercel-comm-12), undermining confidence in seamless massive-scale behavior.
